linked_datasheet_max_discharge_basis: 785060 specification section 8.3.2: discharge current <=2C5A; with rated C5 capacity 2500 mAh, 2C5 = 5.0 A. This is a derived current from the datasheet C-rate notation, not a literal row labelled 5 A max discharge.
board_connector: J4 D-781 manual pigtail -> Molex Micro-Lock Plus 2.0 5055700201
notes: First-five procurement is Adafruit Product 328, not a generic LP785060 family name. Accept incoming packs only if they match the supplier-linked datasheet envelope and polarity is meter-verified before cutting/reterminating the factory JST-PH lead into the frozen D-781 Micro-Lock harness.
